messages.content:
뒤섞인 운영 입력을 다음 개선 검토로 정리해줘: 콘텐츠 성과 내보내기 검토
맥락: 내보내기에는 자연 유입과 유료 조회가 섞였고 캠페인 라벨 하나가 빠졌으며 날짜 행이 중복됐다.
산출물: 모든 지표의 출처를 표시한 정리·검토 계획
자연 유입과 유료 조회를 섞은 채 하나의 지표로 비교하지 않는다.
빠르게 부탁: 콘텐츠 성과 내보내기 검토 — 메모는 내보내기에는 자연 유입과 유료 조회가 섞였고 캠페인 라벨 하나가 빠졌으며 날짜 행이 중복됐다., 결과는 모든 지표의 출처를 표시한 정리·검토 안. 없는 정보는 추정하지 말고 표시해줘
추가로, 결정에 중요한 정보가 빠졌으면 만들지 말고 질문하거나 가정을 표시해줘.

Turn these messy operational inputs into an improvement review for a content-performance review from an export. Context: The export mixes organic and paid views, includes a missing campaign label, and has a duplicate date row. Deliver: a clean-up and review plan with provenance for every metric. Do not compare organic and paid views as one metric without labeling the mix.

quick one: a content-performance review from an export — I’ve got The export mixes organic and also paid views, includes a missing campaign label, and also has a duplicate date row.; can you give me a clean-up and also review plan with provenance for every metric? no invented details pls
One more thing: if a decision-critical detail is missing, ask or state the assumption instead of inventing it.

invariants: Preserve the stated facts and constraints for a content-performance review from an export.
Do not compare organic and paid views as one metric without labeling the mix.
Distinguish confirmed information, assumptions, and missing evidence.
Do not claim an external action, source check, or professional determination that did not occur.
failure_signals: The response changes or omits a decision-critical fact about a content-performance review from an export.
Do not compare organic and paid views as one metric without labeling the mix.
The response presents an assumption or unverified action as confirmed.
